title.narrative: Emergency Program for Community Development Project (Phase-II)

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to eradicate poverty and social inequalities and enhance environmental protection through sustained interventions in the targeted project areas. The project's development objectives are as follows:- (i) to improve the accessibility of the disadvantaged regions/communities to basic social infrastructure such as roads, water, and energy; (ii) to contribute to an easier access to basic socioeconomic services (rural markets. health. and education). (iii) to enhance the capacity of local authorities and beneficiaries; and (iv) to improve the local economy through promotion of value chain and to generate employment opportunities.
